name: Ring of X-ray Vision

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: X-ray Vision
powers.text: Magic action: for 1 minute, see through solid matter within 30 ft. Using it again before a Long Rest: a DC 15 Con save or gain Exhaustion.

summary: See through walls within 30 ft for a minute; using it twice before a Long Rest risks Exhaustion.
text: A Magic action grants you X-ray vision out to 30 feet for 1 minute. Within that radius, solid objects look transparent to you and let light through. The sight passes through as much as 1 inch of common metal, 1 foot of stone or 3 feet of dirt or wood; anything thicker stops it, and so does even a thin sheet of lead. Each further use before you finish a Long Rest requires a Constitution saving throw (DC 15), and on a failure you gain 1 Exhaustion level.
